# AgentCost Report Disclaimer Template

This report is based on the usage data provided, the provider price sources available at the review date, and the formula version shown in the report.

Cost, margin, and savings numbers are deterministic calculations from the submitted snapshot. AI-generated text is an interpretation layer only and should cite `tool:*`, `asset:*`, `risk:*`, `basis:*`, `evidence:*`, or `decision:*` references.

Any model-routing or cheaper-model recommendation is a what-if until representative quality validation passes. AgentCost does not change billing, pricing, routing, Slack, email, or external systems without explicit human approval.
